explanation: erdosproblems.com/1000 attributes to Erdős: lim φ_A(k)/n_k cannot be 0. phiSeq uses divisibility, not the page's ≠, so Lean's claim is formally stronger. It still holds: at the first n_i divisible by a large prime p the ratio is ≥1-1/p, and if only finitely many primes occur then φ(n)/n is bounded below. Definition mismatch noted on erdos_1000.
